description: A heading has a whole form to widen into and should use it before it breaks onto another line. This one is centred on a form 989 wide and is drawn at twenty-eight point, so its translation needs about five hundred pixels on one line and there is room for that. Wrapping it instead took it to three lines and a hundred and two pixels of height, which reached down into the labels beneath it.

known_overlaps.why: The heading widens past the checkbox beside it. AvailableWidth deliberately ignores neighbours it considers movable, on the understanding that a later pass steps them aside, and no pass does. Declared rather than fixed for the same reason as the checkbox fixtures: the resolution has to happen before containers are sized, not after.
